findings.claim: Task 2.2 (strictly validate the OpenSpec change and record refinement/review evidence) is left unchecked while verification.md and refinement_log.md both claim that exact validation ran and passed, leaving the acceptance record self-contradictory for a change whose entire purpose is record accuracy.
findings.evidence: tasks.md line 9: `- [ ] 2.2 Strictly validate the OpenSpec change and record the required refinement and review evidence.`; verification.md: `openspec validate amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence --strict` under 'Commands run' with 'Both checks passed'; refinement_log.md: 'Schema: PASS — openspec validate amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence --strict passed.' The acceptance criteria reproduce the unchecked 2.2, so per the change's own checklist the criterion is unsatisfied even though two artifacts assert it was performed.
findings.suggested_fix: Either mark 2.2 complete if the validation and evidence recording were actually done, or strike the pass claims from verification.md/refinement_log.md until they are.

findings.claim: The change is scoped and justified as amending one contradictory line (Goal 4 naming shadcn), but goals.md is introduced as a brand-new file, so the diff actually creates the entire binding phase goals document — removal targets, exit gates, bundle budgets, process rules — none of which is in the proposal's stated scope, and the claimed pre-existing contradiction is nowhere evidenced in the packet.
findings.evidence: Diff header `new file mode 100644` on goals.md versus proposal.md's premise 'Goal 4 still names shadcn as the frontend primitive owner' and 'What Changes: Amend Goal 4'; design.md's Migration Plan step 2 says 'Amend the Goal 4 line'. The file tree shows no goals.md under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/`, so no prior Goal 4 text exists in the packet to reconcile against.
findings.suggested_fix: If goals.md existed uncommitted, include the before/after of the Goal 4 line so the amendment is reviewable; if it did not exist, re-scope the proposal to 'establish phase goals' so the additional binding content receives explicit review.

findings.claim: The canonical authority document links to the D1 decision record at `../.kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/decision-log.md`, but that file is neither in the diff nor visible in the file tree, so the override's 'rationale of record' and the authority page's precedence chain rest on an unverifiable, possibly dead link.
findings.evidence: ui-design-authority.md: `[Operator decision D1](../.kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/decision-log.md)`; the file tree lists `.kbd-orchestrator/phases` with no decision-log.md, and the same phase directory's goals.md is only created by this diff. proposal.md calls D1 'the rationale of record' and refinement_log.md claims the authority page 'links to the D1 decision record' as a passing check.
findings.suggested_fix: Include decision-log.md (with the D1 entry) in this change or a referenced prerequisite change, and verify the relative link resolves from docs/.

findings.claim: design.md and refinement_log.md assert that the vendored KnowMe standard header already records the D1 exception, but no such header edit appears in this change or the packet, so the claimed intentional header/authority-page duplication cannot be verified and may not exist.
findings.evidence: design.md Context: 'The vendored standard header records the exception' and Risks: 'The same divergence appears in the vendored header and the authority page. The duplication is intentional'; refinement_log.md: 'The vendored standard body and historical documents were not rewritten.' The diff contains no modification to docs/knowme-ui-ux-standard.md.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite the commit/change that added the vendored header exception, or add the header note here and adjust the 'body untouched' claim to 'header annotated'.
